description: This file contains functions for converting various RRC ASN.1 related configurations and identifiers to and from ASN.1 representations, specifically for 5G NR (New Radio) protocol elements. It includes conversion functions for PDCP configurations, SDAP configurations, security algorithms, identifiers, and RAN notification area info, as well as radio bearer configurations.

methods.name: discard_timer_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts a pdcp_discard_timer enum to its ASN.1 representation.

methods.name: t_reordering_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts a pdcp_t_reordering enum to its ASN.1 representation.

methods.name: pdcp_config_to_rrc_nr_asn1
methods.description: Converts a pdcp_config object to its ASN.1 representation for 5G NR.

methods.name: sdap_hdr_ul_cfg_to_rrc_asn1
methods.description: Converts SDAP UL header configuration to ASN.1 options.

methods.name: sdap_hdr_dl_cfg_to_rrc_asn1
methods.description: Converts SDAP DL header configuration to ASN.1 options.

methods.name: sdap_config_to_rrc_asn1
methods.description: Converts SDAP configuration to ASN.1 structure.

methods.name: ciphering_algorithm_to_rrc_asn1
methods.description: Converts security ciphering algorithm enum to ASN.1 representation.

methods.name: integrity_prot_algorithm_to_rrc_asn1
methods.description: Converts security integrity algorithm enum to ASN.1 representation.

methods.name: asn1_to_five_g_s_tmsi
methods.description: Converts ASN.1 bitstring to cu_cp_five_g_s_tmsi object.

methods.name: asn1_to_amf_identifier
methods.description: Converts ASN.1 bitstring to AMF identifier structure.

methods.name: asn1_to_establishment_cause
methods.description: Converts ASN.1 establishment cause options to internal cause enum.

methods.name: asn1_to_resume_cause
methods.description: Converts ASN.1 resume cause options to internal cause enum.

methods.name: asn1_resume_cause_to_establishment_cause
methods.description: Converts ASN.1 resume cause to establishment cause enum.

methods.name: ran_paging_cycle_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts a paging cycle value to ASN.1 enumeration.

methods.name: plmn_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts a PLMN identity to ASN.1 format.

methods.name: ran_notification_area_info_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts RAN notification area info to ASN.1 structure.

methods.name: radio_bearer_config_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts radio bearer configuration to ASN.1 structure.
